Iron Man 2 is a 2010 American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics character Iron Man.[1] It is the sequel to Iron Man (2008).

The film was released in the United States on May 7, 2010, as part of Phase One of the MCU.

Plot

[edit]

In Russia, the media covers Tony Stark's disclosure of his identity as Iron Man.[2] Ivan Vanko builds an arc reactor.

Six months later, Stark has used his armor to help maintain world peace.

Cast

  • Robert Downey Jr. as Tony Stark

Release

The film premiered at the El Capitan Theatre on April 26, 2010, worldwide.

Reception

Box office

Iron Man 2 grossed $312.4 million in the United States and Canada.

Critical response

The review aggregator Rotten Tomatoes reported an approval rating of 71% based on 299 reviews.[90]

Roger Ebert gave the film three stars, praising the performances of Downey and Rourke.
